job_decription:
Founder's Associate – Growth & University Partnerships – Studyhaven (Berlin)

About Studyhaven
Studyhaven helps international students find verified housing before they arrive in Germany. Since launching in 2024 we have housed more than 4,000 students from 60 countries, and we work with 35 universities and 120 landlords. We are a seed-stage team of 16 people backed by European edtech and proptech investors, and we are profitable on a contribution basis in our two core cities, Berlin and Munich.

Why this role exists
Our two founders spend too much time on operations that should be systems. We want a generalist who can take ownership of our partnership engine with universities and student agencies, build repeatable processes and free up founder time for fundraising and product.

What you will do
- Build and manage partnerships with university international offices and student advisory agencies in India, Turkey, Nigeria and Vietnam
- Own the partner pipeline in HubSpot: outreach, first calls, agreements, onboarding and quarterly reviews
- Design our partner onboarding playbook and train two partner managers as we grow
- Run growth experiments with the marketing team (webinars, referral programmes, agency incentives) and report on results
- Prepare monthly founder reviews: partner KPIs, cohort conversion and revenue per partner
- Step in wherever the founders need help: investor material, hiring, pricing analysis

What we are looking for
- 0–3 years of experience in a startup, an advisory business, or as a founder yourself
- Experience working with international students or education agencies is a strong plus
- You are comfortable selling: on calls, in email and in person at education fairs
- Structured and data-literate: Excel/Sheets and a CRM are your daily tools
- Fluent English is required. German is a plus but not required; our team speaks 11 languages and works in English
- Willing to travel 3–4 times a year to partner events

What we offer
- Direct work with both founders and a seat in weekly leadership meetings
- Real ownership: the partnership channel is yours
- Competitive salary (€45–52k) plus virtual share options
- Office in Berlin Friedrichshain, hybrid (3 days in office)
- Learning budget of €1,000 per year

How to apply
Send your CV and a few lines about a partnership you built and what you learned from it. We reply to every application within 7 days.
edge_case: Long JD (>2000 chars) – tests the Notion 2000-char branch
why_expected: Near-perfect match to Rise360 (international students), seed, Berlin, English

job_decription:
Strategy & Operations Associate (CEO Office) – Verdant Routes (Berlin)

Who we are
Verdant Routes makes low-carbon business travel simple. Companies use our platform to book rail-first trips, track travel emissions and stay within their climate targets. We serve 900 corporate customers across Germany, Austria, the Netherlands and the Nordics. After our Series B in early 2026 we are 90 people, headquartered in Berlin.

The team
The CEO Office is a team of three that works across the company on our most important priorities. We sit between the founders, the leadership team and the board. We set the planning rhythm, drive cross-functional initiatives and make sure decisions are made with good data.

Your responsibilities
- Run our quarterly planning process and OKR tracking across eight teams
- Build the monthly business review: revenue, retention, gross margin and emissions KPIs
- Lead 2–3 strategic projects per quarter, for example: entering Switzerland, redesigning our pricing tiers, or evaluating a partnership with a rail operator
- Prepare board meeting materials together with our CFO
- Support the founders with investor relations: data room, updates and follow-ups
- Coordinate leadership offsites and all-hands
- Act as a thought partner to our CEO and challenge assumptions

What you bring
- 0–3 years of experience in strategy consulting, investment banking, venture capital, a high-growth startup, or your own company
- Excellent analytical skills: you are fast in Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable with messy data
- Clear written communication in English (our company language)
- German is helpful but not required
- You enjoy variety and switching between strategy and execution in the same day
- You care about climate impact

What we offer
- Close work with the CEO and exposure to the board
- A clear path into a leadership role within 18–24 months
- Salary €50–58k plus ESOP
- Hybrid in Berlin (office near Ostbahnhof), BahnCard 100 for all employees
- 30 vacation days

Our hiring process
1. 30-minute intro call with our Head of CEO Office
2. Case study (take-home, 3 hours max) and debrief
3. Meeting with our CEO
4. Reference checks and offer
edge_case: Long JD (>2000 chars) – tests the Notion 2000-char branch
why_expected: Strategy & Ops in CEO office, Series B (~90 ppl), Berlin, English
